definitions.explanation: The ratio of a building's footprint (the area it covers on the ground) to the total area of the plot, expressed as a percentage. A legal limit set by zoning that determines how much of a lot may be built on.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六十|ろくじゅう}⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧だ。
examples.english: The building coverage ratio for this lot is sixty percent.

examples.japanese: {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{建|た}てられない→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: You can't build a house that exceeds the building coverage ratio.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}や⟦{容積率|ようせきりつ}→容積率：30020_yousekiritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}められている→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: Limits on the building coverage ratio and floor area ratio are set depending on the area.

notes:
A term from real estate and building regulation. It caps the ground area a building may occupy on its lot; the companion figure ⟦{容積率|ようせきりつ}→容積率：30020_yousekiritsu⟧ caps total floor area. Sometimes written {建蔽率|けんぺいりつ} with the full kanji.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: to exceed the building coverage ratio
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}{六十|ろくじゅう}⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: a coverage ratio of 60%
- {建|けん}ぺい{率|りつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制限|せいげん}→制限：03375_seigen⟧: coverage-ratio restrictions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{容積率|ようせきりつ}→容積率：30020_yousekiritsu⟧: floor area ratio — total floor area relative to the lot, not just the footprint
